items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: So it was Trummy, Dexter Gordon, Ulysses Livingston, with Cee Pee Johnson

ctx.x: 1947. Joe Glaser's office had called me, and he took the picture for me. So after the show, after the picture, they decided that Louis should front a Dixieland band or a small band. And naturally, after working in the band, I was offered the job. I asked for $450 a week, and Frenchy, who was the road manager, and I guess Joe Glaser's sidekick, too, said, 'What!? For a bass player?' And I said, 'Yes, for a bass player. What's $450? You guys make $25,000 a night when the band plays.' So he said, 'That's too much…
